The Cisco Nexus 7000 F3-Series Module integrates the broadest set of data center focused switching technologies, including industry standards as well as Cisco’s own innovations:

Performance: non-blocking 48 ports 1/10GE with 720 million packets per secondof forwarding capacity

Layer2 and Layer3 comprehensive feature set makes this module excellent for data center networks, in which density, performance, and continuous system operation are critical

FabricPath support: with Cisco FabricPath organizations can build resilient, flexible, and if needed, massively scalable Layer 2 networks

Nexus 2000 support: The Cisco Nexus 2000 Series Fabric Extenders (FEX) are designed to simplify data center architecture and operations by dramatically reducing the points of management

VxLAN support: wire rate hardware support for VxLAN which solves the layer2 connectivity problem of multi-tenancy environments

Data Center Interconnect (DCI): OTV and VPLS makes the module ideal in helping customers simplify the extension of applications across geographically dispersed data centers

LISP support: Locator/ID Separation Protocol (LISP) provides enterprises and service providers with the ability to simplify multi-homed routing, and facilitates scalable any-to-any WAN connectivity while supporting data center virtual machine mobility

MPLS: High Performance MPLS -10GE for DC deployments

text.text: Performance: Non-blocking 10GE with 120 Mpps per module and 240 Gbps of data throughput. Scalability: Enables high density 100GE system with up to 384 10GE ports. Supporting large forwarding table (up to 1 million IPv4 routes) with optional Scalable Feature license. Feature Rich: Comprehensive Layer 2 and Layer 3 forwarding functionality, supporting NetFlow, OTV, MPLS and IEEE 1588 Precision Time Protocol (PTP). Security: Support Cisco TrustSec delivers wirespeed data confidentiality and data integrity with IEEE 802.1AE MACsec on all ports.
